snippet.title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Game Features Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Get a slice of the features coming to Marvel’s Wolverine with actor Liam McIntyre. Learn about the combat, story, world, and more that you can sink your claws into.

Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15, 2026, on PlayStation 5 consoles. Pre-order and wishlist now on the PlayStation Store. 

For more information, visit https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/

#ps5 #ps5games #wolverine #marvel 

Rated Mature
